remedies.pluginAuthor: Ask the plugin author for a fixed version.
remedies.catalogAuthor: Ask whoever prepared the catalog for a fixed version.
remedies.downloadAgain: The file may have been damaged while downloading or copying: get the original file again and try again.
remedies.updateStarLight: Update StarLight to the latest version and try again.
remedies.reinstallPlugin: Uninstall it and install it again from the original file.
remedies.reinstallCatalog: Uninstall it and download it again from the Deep-sky catalogs tab of the plugin gallery.
remedies.reinstallStarLight: This plugin is part of StarLight: reinstall the program to restore it.
remedies.retryServer: Try again later; if the problem persists, report it to FM Digital Tools.
remedies.fileChoice: Check that you chose the right file or folder.
remedies.diskSpace: Check that there is free space on the disk and try again.
remedies.repeatPlugin: If it happens again, ask the plugin author for a fixed version.

zip.notZip: The selected file is not a valid ZIP archive.
zip.damaged: The ZIP archive is damaged: some parts cannot be read or do not match their declared size.
zip.password: The archive is password-protected and StarLight cannot open it.
zip.unknownCompression: The archive uses a compression method StarLight does not support (only “stored” and “deflate” are allowed).
zip.disallowedPaths: The archive contains files whose paths lead outside its folder (for example “../”) or point to a drive: this is a way to write files where they do not belong, so the archive was rejected.
zip.duplicateNames: The archive contains the same file twice with different contents: there is no way to know which one is correct.
zip.tooManyFiles: The archive contains too many files to be {what} (maximum {max}).
zip.tooLarge: Once extracted, the archive would take up too much space to be {what} (maximum {mb} MB).
zip.fileTooLarge: The file “{name}” inside the archive is too large (maximum {mb} MB).
zip.zipBomb: The archive is built to inflate enormously when extracted (a few bytes that become a huge amount): this is a known way to exhaust memory, so the archive was rejected.
zip.archiveTooLarge: The archive is too large to be {what} (maximum {mb} MB).
zip.multipleManifests: The archive contains more than one {file} file: it must contain a single plugin or a single catalog.

names.reserved: The name “{name}” is reserved by Windows (like CON, NUL, COM1) and cannot be used for a file or folder.
names.controlCharacters: The “{field}” field contains invisible or control characters, which can distort the displayed text.

isMissing.folderManifest: The folder does not contain a plugin.json file, so it is not a StarLight plugin.
isMissing.archiveManifest: The archive does not contain a plugin.json file, so it is not a StarLight plugin.
isMissing.code: The plugin.js file with the plugin code is missing.
isMissing.image: The image “{name}” declared in the manifest is missing.

plugin.manifestNotJson: The plugin.json file does not contain valid JSON and cannot be read.
plugin.manifestNotObject: The plugin.json file does not contain a valid manifest.
plugin.manifestTooLarge: The plugin.json file is too large (maximum {kb} kB).
plugin.invalidId: The identifier “{id}” can only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (2 to 40 characters).
plugin.invalidVersion: The version must have the form 1.0.0.
plugin.nonOpenLicense: The license “{license}” is not a recognized open source license. StarLight only installs free plugins with an SPDX license such as MIT, Apache-2.0 or GPL-3.0-or-later.
plugin.icon: The icon must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP file in the plugin folder.
plugin.missingPreviews: The before and after previews are missing.
plugin.previews: The previews must be PNG, JPEG or WebP files in the plugin folder.
plugin.invalidMinVersion: The minimum StarLight version must have the form 0.3.0.
plugin.futureMinVersion: This plugin requires StarLight {minimum} or later; the installed version is {app}.
plugin.site: The website, if given, must be an https address.
plugin.geometry: The geometry, if given, must be “unchanged”, “transformed” or “unknown”.
plugin.paramsNotListed: The parameters must be a list.
plugin.tooManyParameters: A plugin can declare at most {max} parameters.

translations.notObject: The “translations” section must be an object with one entry per language code (for example “it”).
translations.tooMany: The “translations” section can contain at most {max} languages.
translations.language: In “translations”, “{language}” is not a valid language code (for example “it” or “pt-BR”).
translations.entry: The “{language}” translation must be an object with the fields name, description and parameters.
translations.text: In the “{language}” translation, the text “{field}” is not valid (it must not be empty, must not contain control characters and can be at most {max} characters long).
translations.unknownParameter: The “{language}” translation refers to the parameter “{id}”, which the manifest does not declare.
translations.options: In the “{language}” translation, the options of “{id}” must be an object, and only a choice parameter has options.
translations.unknownOption: The “{language}” translation refers to the option “{value}” of the parameter “{id}”, which the manifest does not declare.

parameter.id: the id must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores (up to 40).
parameter.label: the label is missing or too long (maximum 60 characters).
parameter.hint: the hint is not valid (maximum 400 characters).
parameter.minMax: the slider requires numeric min and max, with max greater than min.
parameter.step: the slider step must be greater than zero and no larger than the range between min and max.
parameter.defaultOutside: the default value must be between min and max.
parameter.format: the format must be percent, decimal, integer or degrees.
parameter.whole: with the “integer” format, min, max, step and default must be whole numbers.
parameter.tooLargeItems: min and max must be between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000.
parameter.toggle: the toggle requires a true or false default.
parameter.option: every option requires a value and a label, neither empty nor too long.
parameter.duplicateOption: the value “{value}” appears in two options.
parameter.defaultChosen: the default must be one of the option values.
parameter.type: the type “{type}” does not exist: the allowed types are slider, toggle and choice.

plugin.codeTooLarge: The plugin.js file is too large (maximum {mb} MB).
plugin.codeWithoutProcess: The plugin.js file must export the “processImage” function (export function processImage(image, params, context)).
plugin.importCode: The plugin.js file cannot import other modules: all the code must be in that file.
plugin.codeNotText: The plugin.js file is not readable text (it contains bytes that are not valid UTF-8).
plugin.imageTooLarge: The image “{name}” is too large (maximum {mb} MB).
plugin.fakeImage: The file “{name}” is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
plugin.oversizedImage: The image “{name}” has excessive or unreadable dimensions (maximum {side} pixels per side).
plugin.unreadableFolder: The folder could not be read: {detail}.
plugin.copyFailed: The plugin could not be copied: {detail}.
plugin.notInGallery: The plugin is not in the bundled gallery.
plugin.differentFolder: The plugin folder is named “{folder}”, but its manifest declares the identifier “{id}”: the two names must match.

isMissing.manifest: The catalog.json file is missing, so this is not a StarLight catalog.
isMissing.archiveManifest: The archive does not contain a catalog.json file, so it is not a StarLight catalog.
isMissing.objects: The objects.tsv file with the catalog objects is missing.
isMissing.stars: The stars.bin file with the package stars is missing.
isMissing.license: The package is missing the data license text (a LICENSE.txt file).

catalog.manifestNotJson: The catalog.json file does not contain valid JSON and cannot be read.
catalog.manifestNotObject: The catalog.json file does not contain a valid manifest.
catalog.manifestTooLarge: The catalog.json file is too large (maximum {kb} kB).
catalog.futureFormat: The catalog uses a newer format than this version of StarLight can read.
catalog.unrecognizedFormat: The catalog format is not recognized (the “format” field must be 2).
catalog.fieldTooLong: The “{key}” field is too long (maximum {max} characters).
catalog.invalidId: The catalog identifier can only contain lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (2 to 40 characters).
catalog.invalidVersion: The version must have the form 1.2.3.
catalog.unknownType: The package type “{type}” is not supported by this version of StarLight.
catalog.inconsistentGroup: The group “{group}” does not match the package type.
catalog.nonOpenLicense: The license “{license}” is not one of the open licenses allowed for data (CC0, CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, ODbL, public domain and similar).
catalog.objectCount: The number of objects is missing or is not a positive whole number.
catalog.tooManyObjects: The catalog declares too many objects for StarLight (maximum {max}).
catalog.limitMagnitude: The limiting magnitude of the stars is missing or is not a number between 0 and 20.
catalog.objectsTooBig: The objects.tsv file is too large for a catalog (maximum {mb} MB).
catalog.objectsNotText: The objects.tsv file is not readable text (it contains bytes that are not valid UTF-8).
catalog.objectsEmpty: The objects.tsv file contains no readable objects.
catalog.malformedRows: In the objects.tsv file, {bad} rows out of {total} are unreadable or have impossible values ({example}): too many for the catalog to be reliable.
catalog.tooManyLines: The objects.tsv file contains too many rows for a catalog (maximum {max}).
catalog.differentNumber: The manifest declares {declared} objects, but {read} are read from the file: the package is incomplete or does not match its manifest.

row.coordinates: coordinates outside the sky (RA between 0 and 360 degrees, Dec between -90 and +90)
row.long: a row that is too long

catalog.starsTooLarge: The stars.bin file is too large for a star package (maximum {mb} MB).
catalog.starsDifferentCount: The stars.bin file contains {read} stars, but the manifest declares {declared}.
catalog.fainterStars: The stars.bin file contains stars down to magnitude {found}, but the manifest declares a limit of {limit}: the two are inconsistent.
catalog.starsOutsideCell: In the stars.bin file, {count} stars are recorded in the wrong sky zone: the index does not match the data and plate solving would give wrong results.
catalog.differentPackage: The downloaded package contains a different catalog from the one selected.
catalog.fingerprint: The downloaded file does not match the original (different SHA-256 hash): it was not installed.
catalog.largest: The downloaded file is larger than expected.
catalog.copyFailed: The catalog could not be copied: {detail}.
catalog.differentFolder: The catalog folder is named “{folder}”, but its manifest declares the identifier “{id}”: the two names must match.
catalog.unreadableFile: The file {name} could not be read from disk.
catalog.invalidTranslations: The “translations” field must hold the translated texts for each language code (it, fr…).
catalog.invalidNoteLanguages: The “noteLanguages” field must be a list of distinct language codes (it, fr…), at most {max}.

stars.shortValue: The star file is too short.
stars.signature: The file does not contain stars for plate solving.
stars.futureFormat: The star file uses a newer format than this version of StarLight can read.
stars.unrecognizedFormat: The star file format is not recognized.
stars.incomplete: The star file is incomplete: its length does not match the index.

execution.forbiddenTail: , because they have no access to the network, files or devices.
execution.withoutProcess: the plugin does not export the “processImage” function
execution.noImage: the plugin did not return an image
execution.dimensions: the plugin returned an image with invalid dimensions
execution.channels: the plugin returned an invalid number of channels (1 or 3 are allowed)
execution.dataType: the plugin must return the data as a Float32Array
execution.tooLarge: the plugin returned an image that is too large
execution.length: the data returned by the plugin does not match the declared dimensions
execution.nonFinite: the plugin returned {count} non-numeric values (NaN or infinite) out of {total}
execution.outOfRange: the plugin returned out-of-range values (for example {value}, while StarLight works with values close to the 0 to 1 range)
execution.withoutTransform: the plugin declares that it moves pixels but did not return the transformation (a 2×3 matrix of numbers, or “unknown”)
execution.incoherentTransformation: the plugin returned a transformation that does not match the returned image (pixels would end up outside the image)
execution.time: the plugin did not finish within {seconds} seconds and was stopped
execution.memory: the plugin used too much memory (over {size}) and was stopped
execution.crashed: the separate environment the plugin runs in closed unexpectedly
execution.startupFailed: the plugin code could not start
execution.error: an error occurred in the plugin code (“{detail}”)
execution.codeChanged: the plugin.js file changed after startup and no longer passes the checks

messages.notLoaded: {subject} was not loaded because it does not pass the security checks.
messages.galleryButtons: The gallery has buttons to uninstall or reinstall it.
messages.notLoadedSummary: {count} plugins and catalogs were not loaded because they do not pass the security checks:
messages.summaryGallery: The gallery shows the problem found for each one and the buttons to uninstall or reinstall it.
messages.stoppedDetail: The image stays as it was before the plugin, the rest of the processing has been applied, and the plugin stays suspended until StarLight is next opened.
messages.stoppedAgainDetail: The image stays as it was before the plugin, and the plugin stays suspended until StarLight is next opened.
messages.stoppedAgainSessions: It has now stopped because of an error in {sessions} sessions. You can disable it permanently with the button next to this message and enable it again when the author releases a fixed version.
messages.suspendedSkipped: {subject} is suspended for this session after an error and was not applied. It will be available again the next time you open StarLight.
messages.catalogExcludedDetail: The other catalogs and object recognition work normally.
messages.starsExcludedDetail: Plate solving continues with the online Gaia catalog, if internet access is allowed.

gallery.plugin: The plugin does not pass the security checks and is not loaded.
gallery.catalog: The catalog does not pass the security checks and is not loaded.
gallery.suspended: Suspended for this session after an error: it will be available again the next time you open StarLight.
gallery.reinstallPluginTitle: Choose the plugin's original .zip archive again (for a folder, use “From a folder…” at the bottom of the gallery)
gallery.reinstallCatalogTitle: Choose the catalog's original .zip archive again
gallery.downloadAgainTitle: Downloads the catalog again from the StarLight server and replaces the damaged copy
gallery.uninstallTitle: Deletes the folder from the disk
gallery.notLoadedTitle: Does not pass the security checks: StarLight does not load it.
